description.zh:
备份任务ID。
> 如果您调用[CreateBackup](~~473819~~)执行了手动备份，您可以将返回的备份ID传入，用以查询备份的进度。
description.en:
The ID of the backup task.

>  If you call the [CreateBackup](~~473819~~) operation to perform a manual backup task, you can set this parameter to the returned backup ID to query the backup progress of the task.
The instance ID. You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~473778~~) operation to query instance IDs.

description.zh:
备份模式，取值：
* **Automated**：系统自动备份，您可以调用[DescribeBackupPolicy](~~473822~~)查询自动备份策略。
* **Manual**：手动备份

> 默认返回所有备份模式的任务信息。
description.en:
The backup mode. Valid values:

*   **Automated**: automatic backup. You can call the [DescribeBackupPolicy](~~473822~~) operation to query the automatic backup policy.
*   **Manual**: manual backup.

>  By default, the information about backup tasks in both modes is returned.

title.zh: 查询备份任务执行情况

example.unifiedCli: aliyun r-kvstore describe-backup-tasks --instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --backup-job-id 11620000 --job-mode Manual --region cn-hangzhou
